identity: Source identifiers in properties.details qualify each record. Array position is not a longitudinal identity.

fields.name: geometry
fields.description: Longitude, latitude; WGS84, rounded to four decimals. Approximate.

fields.name: properties.mode
fields.description: Reviewed reported travel category; source conflict remains in details and overview.

fields.name: properties.month
fields.description: Historical display month. Inspect prepared dates for occurrence versus PD report date.

fields.name: properties.source
fields.description: Historical display label. Prepared filters.sources and details retain source-specific provenance.

fields.name: properties.details
fields.description: Approved source-prefixed scalar fields. Police, UDOT, Portal and Provenance namespaces. Missing/null is not a negative value; nested person/vehicle records are source-qualified text, not stable person identities.

fields.name: properties.prepared.filters
fields.description: Arrays: years, modeGroups, fineModes, crashSeverity, factors, lighting, sources. atSeverity is a string: serious-fatal, other, unknown. OR within a filter, AND across filters; an empty selected year/mode/source set matches nothing.

fields.name: properties.prepared.overview
fields.description: Source-qualified dates, location labels, injury/severity and circumstances arrays; boolean modeConflict; availability and timeNotes arrays. These are prepared shared interpretations, not app recalculations.

fields.name: properties.summary
fields.description: Sections {heading, entries:[{key,label,values:[{text,sources: string[]}]}]}. Only reviewed common concepts appear; full-precision location.point is excluded.
